full.description: This image is a photomicrograph of thyroid gland tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. It shows thyroid follicles of various sizes filled with eosinophilic colloid material and lined by single layers of follicular cells. The histological appearance is consistent with normal or hyperplastic thyroid tissue.

random.description: This image is a photomicrograph of thyroid tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. It shows numerous variably sized follicles filled with eosinophilic colloid material. The follicular lining cells appear flattened in some distended follicles. The overall histological appearance is characteristic of a multinodular goiter or colloid goiter.
